skill.name: zoho-crm-automation
skill.description: Automate Zoho CRM record discovery, creation, updates, lead conversion, tags, and related records through Rube MCP.
skill.summary: Guide reliable Zoho CRM workflows with schema discovery, targeted searches, and structured record operations.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: All external-command alerts are Markdown false positives, and the reconnaissance alert describes a Zoho record ID. Rube MCP is a real third-party network dependency, while CRM mutations lack an explicit confirmation requirement.

remediation.issue: Mutating CRM workflows lack a confirmation gate.
remediation.suggestion: Require a preview and explicit user confirmation before record creation, updates, related-record changes, and irreversible lead conversion.

remediation.issue: Zoho access depends on an external MCP service.
remediation.suggestion: Document Rube data handling, required OAuth scopes, and the records transmitted through the service before users connect production CRM accounts.

static_findings.snippet: - Active Zoho CRM connection via `RUBE_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS` with toolkit `zoho`
- Always call `RUBE_SEARCH_TOOLS` first to get current tool schemas
**Get Rube MCP**: Add `https://rube.app/mcp` as an MCP server in your client configuration. No API k

2. `ZOHO_GET_MODULE_FIELDS` - Get field definitions for a module [Optional]
- `fields`: Comma-separated list of fields to return
1. `ZOHO_GET_MODULE_FIELDS` - Get required fields for the module [Prerequisite]
- `data`: Record data object with field-value pairs
- `record_id`: ID of the record to update
- `data`: Object with fields to update (only changed fields needed)
- `lead_id`: ID of the lead to convert
- `deal`: Deal details if creating a deal during conversion
**Get Rube MCP**: Add `https://rube.app/mcp` as an MCP server in your client configuration. No API k
- record_id must be the Zoho record ID (numeric string)

content.user_title: Automate Zoho CRM Records and Lead Workflows
content.value_statement: Manual CRM updates consume time and can introduce inconsistent data. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through Zoho workflows using Rube MCP.
actual_capabilities: Discovers available Zoho CRM modules and field schemas before operations.
Searches records with criteria, selected fields, and pagination.
Creates records using module-specific field data.
Updates identified records while preserving unspecified fields.
Converts leads into contacts, accounts, and optional deals.
Creates module tags and updates related records.
limitations: Requires Rube MCP and an active Zoho OAuth connection.
Access is limited by the connected user's Zoho role and permissions.
Record creation can produce duplicates unless Zoho duplicate rules prevent them.
Lead conversion is irreversible and depends on configured field mappings.

use_cases.title: Qualify Incoming Leads
use_cases.description: Search existing leads, create missing records, and prepare validated lead conversions.

use_cases.title: Maintain Customer Records
use_cases.description: Find contacts and accounts, then apply precise field updates using verified record IDs.

use_cases.title: Standardize CRM Operations
use_cases.description: Discover module schemas, manage tags, and maintain relationships across configured modules.

prompt_templates.title: Find a Contact
prompt_templates.prompt: Verify the Zoho connection and search Contacts for email {{email}}. Return {{fields}} without changing any records.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a New Lead
prompt_templates.prompt: Discover required Lead fields and check for {{email}}. Prepare a lead from {{lead_details}}, then ask before creating it.
prompt_templates.scenario: Create a lead with duplicate checking

prompt_templates.title: Update a Deal
prompt_templates.prompt: Find the Deal matching {{criteria}} and show its ID and current {{fields}}. Update only {{changes}} after I confirm.
prompt_templates.scenario: Controlled update to an existing deal

prompt_templates.title: Convert a Qualified Lead
prompt_templates.prompt: Find {{lead_identifier}}, validate Contact, Account, and Deal mappings, and preview outcomes. Convert the lead only after explicit confirmation.

output_examples.input: Find the contact with email alex@example.com and return the name and phone.
output_examples.output: Found one contact: Alex Morgan. Phone: +1 555 010 4420. No records were changed.

output_examples.input: Prepare a lead for Priya Shah at Northwind using priya@example.com.
output_examples.output: No matching lead was found. The required fields are ready for review, and creation is waiting for confirmation.

output_examples.input: Convert lead 4100000123456 and create a deal worth 15000.
output_examples.output: Conversion preview: one Contact, one Account, and one 15000 deal. The irreversible action is waiting for explicit confirmation.

best_practices: Call RUBE_SEARCH_TOOLS and inspect current schemas before every workflow.
Search for existing records and confirm record IDs before writes.
Preview changes and require explicit confirmation before creation, updates, or lead conversion.
anti_patterns: Do not use display labels when Zoho requires field API names.
Do not update a record selected only by a broad or ambiguous search.
Do not convert leads without reviewing mappings and confirming the irreversible action.

faq.question: Does this skill require a Zoho API key?
faq.answer: Rube MCP handles the connection flow, but you must authorize Zoho through OAuth.

faq.question: Which Zoho records can it manage?
faq.answer: It supports modules exposed by your Zoho permissions and the available Rube tools.

faq.question: Can it prevent duplicate records?
faq.answer: No. Search for matches before creation and rely on configured Zoho duplicate rules.

faq.question: Does it support bulk operations?
faq.answer: The guidance focuses on individual and paginated operations. Bulk work must respect plan limits and current tool schemas.

faq.question: Can lead conversion be undone?
faq.answer: No. Zoho lead conversion is irreversible, so review mappings and confirm before execution.

faq.question: Why should tools and fields be discovered first?
faq.answer: Schemas can change. Discovery confirms required fields, API names, and available actions.
